description:
The PV Solar String Monitoring System is a new device developed to monitor currents and voltage at the string level inside a combiner box.

In order to have a flexible design that can fit any customer's requirements, the Solar String Monitoring System (Solar SMS) has been developed as a modular system.

It consists of:
•	The Master Module, which includes the power supply and communication infrastructure (RS-485) to coordinate data gathering from sensors. 
•	The Slave Modules, which collect current data with the usage of hall effect sensors. These modules can mount 8 or 12 sensors each with 25A and 50A sensors respectively. Solar SMS 

Number of monitored channels: Controls up to 32 channels
